newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Telstra, AAPT sign with PanAmSat.
newsitem.headline: Telstra, AAPT sign with PanAmSat.

text.p: Australian telecommunications groups Telstra Corp Ltd and AAPT Telecommunications Pty Ltd on Tuesday agreed with PanAmSat Corp to use the PAS Pacific Ocean Region satellite, PanAmSat said.
PanAmSat said in a statement issued in Australia that the new service agreements are PanAmSat's first to provide satellite capacity for domestic use in Australia.
The announcement coincides with the first day of deregulation of Australia's telecommunications market.
It said the satellite deal would boost Telstra's and AAPT's ability to offer digital voice, video and data communications.
